additional_info.body:
Hi Tom,
The attached picture you shared with us for updating on this charger doesn't meet the requirement.
See below error:
For screen saver, we need image resolution as 1080 X 1920 pixel, however you have shared it otherway round i.e. 1920X1080 pixel.
For Logo, the image can be of a lower resolution, as the resolution of Logo is compatible very low w.r.t Screensaver image, as Screensaver uses the complete display.
Hope this clarifies.
Thank you.
